The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (0 == STRCMP(pReceivedSignalingMessage->signalingMessage.peerClientId, pSampleConfiguration->sampleStreamingSessionList[i]->peerId)) {
    pSampleStreamingSession = pSampleConfiguration->sampleStreamingSessionList[i];
    sessionExisted = TRUE;
}
```
Reason:
The code checks if the incoming offer's client ID matches an existing session's peer ID. If it does, it sets `sessionExisted` to `TRUE`, which leads to ignoring new offers from clients with the same client ID, causing the master to not process incoming offers correctly in trickle ICE mode.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
ATOMIC_COMPARE_EXCHANGE_BOOL(&pSampleStreamingSession->sdpOfferAnswerExchanged, &expected, TRUE)
```
Reason:
This statement introduces a mechanism to track whether an offer has already been processed by using an atomic boolean. It ensures that if an offer has been received, subsequent offers from the same client ID are ignored, thus preventing conflicts and ensuring correct behavior when handling multiple offers.
